title: Delete Part on a part with a pending credit shows the return-or-credit hover text and does nothing
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. API replays from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Data: QAPL-T5 with a pending credit on a part sale (not on a work order, no open return). DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-T5.
  2. Hover over Delete Part.
  3. Click Delete Part.
  4. Close the dialog. Create a scratch part QAPL-DEL5 (New Inventory Part, unused), open it and click Delete Part; in Network keep that delete request.
  5. Replay that delete request with QAPL-T5's part id in place of QAPL-DEL5's.
  6. Parts > Inventory > search "QAPL-T5".
custom_expected:
1. "Edit Inventory Part" opens; Delete Part (button_delete_part) is shown and enabled.
  2. The tooltip reads exactly "Please complete or cancel the related return or credit first."
  3. Nothing happens: no delete request in Network, no confirmation, the dialog stays open.
  4. QAPL-DEL5 is deleted at once with no confirmation; the delete request is captured.
  5. The delete is refused with the error "Inventory part with an open return or a pending credit cannot be deleted." (only that message).
  6. QAPL-T5 is still listed, with its pending credit.
